title: Hockey Season Schedule Data
description: Response of the season schedule endpoint (/schedule?tournament=...&season=...). A flat array of games, deserialized as Vec<ScheduleApiGame>. Note that several field types differ from the games-by-date endpoint documented in game_schedule_schema.json — most notably 'serie' is an integer here but a string there.

start.description: Null for unresolved playoff matchups; the app maps null to an empty string

homeTeamName.description: Null for unresolved playoff matchups; the app maps null to an empty string

awayTeamName.description: Null for unresolved playoff matchups; the app maps null to an empty string

serie.description: Integer on this endpoint, unlike the games-by-date endpoint where serie is a string (e.g. "RUNKOSARJA")
